response.minimum_structural_length_meaning: Unconditional parser prefix only: 3-byte header + u32 state + u8 privacy. Optional fields need more (offset 8 needs >= 9, offset 9 needs >= 10, offsets 10-11 need >= 15, offset 15 needs >= 16, offset 16 needs >= 17, offset 17 needs >= 18); see z2_guard_chain in evidence.
response.opcode_aliasing: Opcode 3 is NOT globally unique: o3 (HeartbeatPing, no parsed fields) shares it. z2 (GetStateRsp) is selected by the outstanding-request callback registered in q.f for the getState request, not by opcode alone.
response.z2_guard_chain: From z2<init> bytecode: len>=9 -> d,e@8; len>=10 -> f@9; len>=15 -> j@10,k@11; len>=16 -> g@15; len>=17 -> h@16; len>=18 -> i@17. Shorter frames return early with fewer fields parsed.
response.offset_8_evidence: CONFIRMED SDK-derived, 2026-09-21, from plaud-sdk.aar classes.jar bytecode (parsed with jawa, no decompiler): z2<init> executes d=u8@8 and e=(u8@8)==1 when length>=9. z2.toString gives the real class name GetStateRsp and maps keyState<-e, so key_state is bool-valued; the deterministic fixture uses 1 so a real parse reports keyState=1 (a raw byte of 2 would report 0). d is the SDK-internal raw byte at the same offset, unused by toString.
response.success_condition: z2 constructor succeeds and opcode equals 3; null parse is treated as no result
